# Columbia International Affairs Online (CIAO)

> > Columbia International Affairs Online provides access to scholarly publications on international relations, terrorism studies, and global security analysis.

CIAO hosts academic journals and research on counterterrorism, regional conflicts, and security issues. The collection includes publications from institutions like the Combating Terrorism Center at West Point, covering topics from AQIM operations in the Sahel to transnational security threats.

## Key Topics

- Counterterrorism
- AQIM (Al-Qaeda in the Islamic Maghreb)
- Sahel region security
- Foreign fighters
- CTC Sentinel journal
- Combating Terrorism Center at West Point
- Mali and Northern Mali conflicts
- Political violence
- Drug cartels
- Maritime piracy
- Syria conflict
- West Africa security
- Terrorism analysis
- Knights Templar cartel

## Terrorism & Security Journals

- [CTC Sentinel](https://ciaotest.cc.columbia.edu/journals/cs/v7i4/index.html): Combating Terrorism Center journal on AQIM, foreign fighters & security
